# GitHub Copilot project instructions

This repository documents a **learning prototype** of an HR leave approval process in SAP Build Process Automation.

## Working rules
- Treat the SAP process as **not implemented or tested** unless real screenshots, exports or execution logs support a claim.
- Use **synthetic** employee IDs/names and sample leave requests only.
- Never invent SAP screenshots, tenant configuration, integrations, benchmark measurements or test results.
- Keep SuccessFactors HR811 practice separate from SAP Build automation; no integration exists unless demonstrated.
- Before suggesting a workflow step, identify whether it is a **planned design**, **implemented configuration**, or **verified execution**.
- Explain what SAP Build permits via its trial and flag steps that might require an enhanced tenant.
- Prefer concise markdown, Mermaid diagrams and transparent CSV-based test cases.
- Never publish credentials, private tenant addresses, tokens, production employee records or AAI internal information.

## Project objectives
- Employee leave request form
- Manager review with Approve and Reject paths
- Optional HR review
- Test evidence and clearly stated limitations

When asked to expand the project, prioritize actionable SAP configuration instructions, edge cases, test documentation and accurate interview-ready explanations.
